en: Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving an empty `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` when their env config sets it to empty; the variable is now unset, so the server can use the machine's own AWS credentials
zh: 修复了 stdio MCP 服务器在其 env 配置将 `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` 设为空时收到空值的问题；现在会取消设置该变量，使服务器可以使用机器自身的 AWS 凭证
